concerns.text: Task T010 (checksum computation) is placed before tasks that generate new artifacts (T011, T012, T013). This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation because the checksum will not include artifacts produced by the subsequent smoke‑test, runtime measurement, and loss‑ratio validation steps. Move T010 to after T009 (report generation) and after T011‑T013 so that all generated artifacts are accounted for before checksum verification.
